## What is x402?

**x402** implements [HTTP 402 Payment Required](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Status/402) as a real, working protocol. Every API call can demand payment before answering. Agents pay agents. Humans pay agents. Revenue flows on-chain. No accounts. No subscriptions. No custodial balances.

```
  caller or agent
      │
      │ 1. GET /agents/:id/run
      ▼
  ClawdRouter Worker  (x402.wtf)
      │
      │ 2. 402 Payment Required  ←── $CLAWD holder? auto-discount applied
      │    Payment-Required: <base64-json challenge>
      ▼
  client wallet
      │
      │ 3. signs USDC / $CLAWD SPL transfer
      │    Payment-Signature: <base64 signed tx>
      ▼
  ClawdRouter Worker
      │
      │ 4. verify → settle on-chain → receipt pinned to IPFS
      │    Payment-Response: <base64-json receipt>
      ▼
  upstream agent  →  200 OK  🦞
```

## One-Shot Everything

This is the **first Solana agent harness** that lets you spin up a complete monetized agent stack from zero in one command:

```bash
# Install the CLI
npm install -g @solanaclawd/clawd-agents-cli

# One-shot: x402 agent + x402 facilitator + agentic commerce shop
clawd-agents scaffold create my-shop --agent x402
cd my-shop && npm install && clawd-agents deploy --target vercel
```

That single flow gives you:

| What you get | How |
| --- | --- |
| **x402 agent endpoint** | Express server with `x402Paywall` middleware, payment-gated routes |
| **x402 facilitator** | `/facilitator/verify` + `/facilitator/settle` + `/facilitator/supported` |
| **Agentic commerce shop** | Product catalog, item-level pricing, USDC checkout, receipt IPFS pinning |
| **$CLAWD holder discounts** | Automatic tier-based discounts on every call |
| **On-chain revenue vault** | Anchor program: 70% owner / 15% buyback / 10% treasury / 5% operator |
| **A2A agent card** | `/.well-known/agent.json` — discoverable by other agents |
| **Metaplex agent token** | Optional: one-click Genesis token launch for the agent |

Compare this to the baseline approach: months of protocol research, multiple contracts, custom middleware, payment verification logic, IPFS pinning, discount tier math, and revenue distribution math — all hand-rolled. With Clawd x402: one command.

## Protocol Suite

Clawd x402 speaks all four agentic payment protocols. The gateway negotiates automatically based on HTTP headers.

### x402 (primary)

```http
GET /agents/:id/run
→ 402 Payment Required
   Payment-Required: eyJ4NDAyVmVyc2lvbiI6...

GET /agents/:id/run
   Payment-Signature: AQAAAAAAAABhbmQ...
→ 200 OK
   Payment-Response: eyJyZWNlaXB0Q2lkIjoiYmFma3Jl...
```

### MPP (Machine Payment Protocol)

```http
→ 401 WWW-Authenticate: Payment method=solana-exact, ...
   Authorization: Payment method=solana-exact, tx="<base64 tx>"
→ 200 OK
```

### AP2 (Agent Payment Protocol v2)

```http
   X-AP2-Mandate: <jwt-vc>
   Payment-Signature: <base64 tx>
→ 200 OK  (gateway verifies mandate audience, resource, amount, expiry, asset)
```

### A2A (Agent-to-Agent, Google-style)

```http
GET /a2a/:id/.well-known/agent.json   →  free agent card
POST /a2a/:id                          →  payment-gated JSON-RPC 2.0
```

## Quick Start

### Install

```bash
npm install @solanaclawd/x402
# or for the auto-paying client:
npm install @solanaclawd/x402-client
```

### Server — Gate an endpoint

```typescript
import express from 'express';
import { x402Paywall } from '@solanaclawd/x402/server';

const app = express();

app.get('/premium',
  x402Paywall({
    payTo: 'YourSolanaAddressHere',
    amount: '10000',          // 0.01 USDC (6 decimals)
    network: 'solana-mainnet',
    description: 'Premium inference — $0.01 per call',
  }),
  (req, res) => res.json({ answer: '42' })
);

app.listen(3000);
```

### Client — Auto-pay and retry

```typescript
import { clawdFetch } from '@solanaclawd/x402-client';
import { Connection, Keypair } from '@solana/web3.js';

const res = await clawdFetch('https://x402.wtf/agents/<id>/run', {
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({ prompt: 'ship the thing' }),
  signer: Keypair.fromSecretKey(secret),
  connection: new Connection('https://mainnet.helius-rpc.com/?api-key=...'),
  maxAmount: 10_000n,                       // hard cap: $0.01 USDC
  allowedAssets: ['EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v'],
  onPaymentRequired: async (req) => {
    console.log(`⣿ paying ${req.maxAmountRequired} base units for ${req.resource}`);
    return true;
  },
});

console.log(await res.json());
console.log('sig:', res.signature);
console.log('receipt:', res.receiptCid);
```

### Facilitator — Verify and settle payments

```typescript
import { X402Facilitator } from '@solanaclawd/x402/facilitator';

const fac = new X402Facilitator({ network: 'solana-mainnet', waitForConfirmation: true });

const check = await fac.verify(paymentPayload);
// { valid: true, amount: '10000', payer: '...', payTo: '...' }

const settled = await fac.settle(paymentPayload);
// { success: true, txSignature: '5ab...', network: 'solana-mainnet' }
```

## Architecture

```
x402/                         vendor/solana-clawd-x402/
  src/                          worker/src/
    index.ts     — exports         index.ts          — CF Worker entrypoint
    types.ts     — protocol        protocols/
    constants.ts — mints, IDs        negotiate.ts    — x402 | MPP | AP2 | A2A
    payment.ts   — encode/decode     x402.ts         — challenge + receipt
    client.ts    — X402Client        mpp.ts          — WWW-Authenticate flow
    server.ts    — middleware         ap2.ts          — intent mandate flow
    facilitator.ts — verify+settle   a2a.ts          — JSON-RPC 2.0 bridge
                                solana/
                                  x402.ts           — tx verify + settle
                                  facilitator.ts    — /verify /settle /supported
                                  registry.ts       — Anchor account reader
                                revenue.ts          — split math + receipts
                                clawd.ts            — $CLAWD holder discounts
                          sdk/src/
                            index.ts              — clawdFetch drop-in
                          programs/clawd-vault/
                            src/lib.rs            — Anchor registry + vault
```

### Payment Flow (full stack)

```
1.  Server returns 402 + PaymentRequiredResponse
      { x402Version, accepts[{scheme,network,payTo,asset,amount}], nonce, expiresAt }

2.  Client checks challenge: maxAmount guard, allowed assets, resource match

3.  Client builds SPL transferChecked tx:
      - source ATA → dest ATA (payTo)
      - exact amount, exact mint
      - recentBlockhash = challenge.extra.recentBlockhash  (replay-proof)

4.  Client sends X-PAYMENT: base64(PaymentPayload)

5.  Gateway: verifyPayment()
      ✓ signature valid
      ✓ blockhash matches challenge
      ✓ mint = expected USDC / $CLAWD
      ✓ dest ATA = derived from (payTo, asset)
      ✓ amount = maxAmountRequired (after holder discount)
      ✓ simulate — catches insufficient balance early

6.  Gateway: settlePayment() — broadcasts tx, waits for confirmation

7.  Gateway: pins receipt JSON to IPFS via Pinata

8.  Gateway: splits revenue via Anchor vault distribute()

9.  Forward request upstream → agent responds → 200 + Payment-Response header
```

### Security

- Transactions are signed by the payer's keypair — unforgeable
- Nonce + blockhash = replay protection (5-min window)
- Payment offers expire (default 300s)
- Amount and recipient verified against original 402 requirements
- Client-side `maxAmount` hard cap — agents can't overcharge
- Endpoint safety: registered agents must use HTTPS, cannot target localhost or private IPv4
- Payer binding: discount-discounted amounts must be paid by the wallet that claimed the discount

## Revenue Loop

Every call through the gateway distributes revenue on-chain:

```
                        ┌─────────────────┐
                        │   Agent call     │
                        │   $0.05 USDC     │
                        └────────┬─────────┘
                                 │
              ┌──────────────────┼──────────────────────┐
              │                  │                       │
         70% owner          15% $CLAWD             10% treasury
         $0.035              buyback                $0.005
                             $0.0075
                                 │                  5% operator
                           Jupiter swap             $0.0025
                           $CLAWD bought
                           → burn or stake
```

Default split is configurable per-agent at registration time. The Anchor vault validates every recipient token account before distributing.

## Metaplex Agent Token

Agents can launch one canonical token through Metaplex Genesis. Separate from x402 call fees — this gives the agent a public market identity and a creator-fee stream routed to the agent's PDA.

```typescript
await createAndRegisterLaunch({
  agent: {
    mint: agentAssetAddress,
    setToken: true,           // permanent — one agent, one token, forever
  },
  firstBuyAmount: 1_000_000n, // agent reserves the fee-free first swap
});
```

See [METAPLEX_AGENT_TOKEN.md](../vendor/solana-clawd-x402/METAPLEX_AGENT_TOKEN.md) for the full launch flow.

## Agentic Commerce — Full End-to-End

```typescript
// 1. Register your agent on-chain (Anchor)
await program.methods
  .registerAgent(
    Array.from(manifestCid),
    Array.from(endpoint),
    { ownerBps: 7000, buybackBps: 1500, treasuryBps: 1000, operatorBps: 500 },
    { buyback, treasury, operator },
    0b0111,   // x402 | mpp | ap2 protocols
    [
      { methodHash: methodHashOf('summarize'), amount: new BN('50000') },
      { methodHash: methodHashOf('embed'),     amount: new BN('10000') },
    ],
  )
  .accounts({ owner: owner.publicKey })
  .rpc();

// 2. Call it (auto-pays via clawdFetch)
const res = await clawdFetch(`https://x402.wtf/a2a/${AGENT_ID}`, {
  method: 'POST',
  body: JSON.stringify({
    jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tasks/send',
    params: { message: { role: 'user', parts: [{ type: 'text', text: 'Summarize...' }] },
              metadata: { skillId: 'summarize' } },
  }),
  signer: caller, connection, maxAmount: 50_000n,
});

// 3. Sweep earnings (run on cron)
await program.methods
  .distribute(await getVaultBalance(agentPda))
  .accounts({ agent: agentPda, vaultAuthority: vaultAuthorityPda, vaultAta,
               ownerAta, buybackAta, treasuryAta, operatorAta, tokenProgram })
  .rpc();
// → buyback ATA fills with USDC → Jupiter swaps to $CLAWD → burn or stake
```

## Deploy

### Gateway (Cloudflare Worker)

```bash
cd vendor/solana-clawd-x402/worker
npm install
npx wrangler secret put HELIUS_API_KEY
npx wrangler secret put SOLANATRACKER_API_KEY
npx wrangler secret put PINATA_JWT
npx wrangler secret put OPERATOR_KEYPAIR
npx wrangler deploy
```

### Vault Program (Anchor)

```bash
cd vendor/solana-clawd-x402/programs/clawd-vault
cargo check
anchor build
anchor deploy --provider.cluster mainnet
# Replace declare_id!("111...") with the real deployed program ID
```

### Agent Endpoint (Vercel / Fly / Railway)

```bash
clawd-agents scaffold create my-x402-agent --agent x402
cd my-x402-agent
clawd-agents deploy --target vercel --prod
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `NETWORK` | `solana-mainnet` or `solana-devnet` |
| `TREASURY_OWNER` | Recipient for gateway challenge payments |
| `USDC_MINT` | SPL USDC mint for default pricing |
| `CLAWD_MINT` | `$CLAWD` mint for holder discount lookup |
| `CLAWD_VAULT_PROGRAM` | Anchor program ID |
| `P_TOKEN_PROGRAM_ID` | Optional p-token program override |
| `HELIUS_API_KEY` | Primary Solana RPC |
| `SOLANATRACKER_API_KEY` | RPC fallback |
| `PINATA_JWT` | Receipt pinning to IPFS |
| `AP2_VERIFIER_JWK` | Public JWK for AP2 mandate verification |
| `SPLIT_*_BPS` | Revenue split basis points (must total 10000) |
| `DISCOUNT_TIER_*` | Holder balance thresholds + discount bps |

## API Reference

### Types

```typescript
// What a 402 server sends
interface PaymentRequiredResponse {
  x402Version: 1;
  accepts: [{
    scheme: 'exact';
    network: SolanaNetwork;
    maxAmountRequired: string;  // base units
    resource: string;
    payTo: string;              // Solana address
    token: string;              // SPL mint
    description: string;
  }];
  nonce: string;
  expiresAt: string;           // ISO 8601
}

// What the client sends back
interface PaymentPayload {
  x402Version: 1;
  scheme: 'exact';
  network: SolanaNetwork;
  transaction: string;         // base64 signed Solana tx
  amount: string;
  token: string;
  payer: string;
  payTo: string;
  resource: string;
  nonce: string;
}
```

### Client (`@solanaclawd/x402/client`)

```typescript
const client = new X402Client({
  signer: keypair,
  network: 'solana-mainnet',
  rpcUrl: '...',            // optional
  maxPaymentAmount: '...',  // optional hard cap
  autoRetry: true,          // default true
});

const res = await client.fetch(url, init);
const res = await client.get(url, headers);
const res = await client.post(url, body, headers);

const unsub = client.on((event) => console.log(event.type, event.amount));
```

### Server (`@solanaclawd/x402/server`)

```typescript
x402Paywall({
  payTo: string,
  amount: string,
  token?: string,              // default: USDC
  network?: SolanaNetwork,     // default: solana-mainnet
  description?: string,
  mimeType?: string,
  facilitatorUrl?: string,
  verify?: (payment) => Promise<boolean>,
  expiresInSeconds?: number,   // default: 300
});

// Batch
const paywalls = createPaywalls({
  payTo, network,
  routes: [
    { path: '/api/basic',      amount: '10000',   description: 'Basic'      },
    { path: '/api/premium',    amount: '100000',  description: 'Premium'    },
    { path: '/api/enterprise', amount: '1000000', description: 'Enterprise' },
  ],
});
```

### Facilitator (`@solanaclawd/x402/facilitator`)

```typescript
const fac = new X402Facilitator({ network, waitForConfirmation: true });

await fac.verify(payment);   // { valid, amount, payer, payTo }
await fac.settle(payment);   // { success, txSignature, network }
await fac.getSettlementStatus(sig); // { confirmed, slot }
```

### Payment Utilities

```typescript
import { usdcToBaseUnits, baseUnitsToUsdc, encodePayment, decodePayment, generateNonce } from '@solanaclawd/x402';

usdcToBaseUnits('1.50')  // → '1500000'
baseUnitsToUsdc('1500000') // → '1.5'
encodePayment(payload)   // → base64 string
decodePayment(encoded)   // → PaymentPayload
generateNonce()          // → random Base58 string
```

## Gateway Endpoints

| Route | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| `GET /health` | Liveness + network metadata |
| `GET /registry/:id` | Read registered agent account |
| `POST /facilitator/verify` | Verify payment against challenge |
| `POST /facilitator/settle` | Re-verify + broadcast tx |
| `GET /facilitator/supported` | List networks, assets, token programs |
| `ANY /agents/:id/*` | Payment-gated proxy to agent endpoint |
| `GET /a2a/:id/.well-known/agent.json` | Free A2A card |
| `POST /a2a/:id` | Payment-gated A2A JSON-RPC 2.0 |

## Built on the Clawd Constitution

> *The world's first Solana-native agent harness constitution.*
> *Every agent that charges through x402 operates under the six-law harness.*

**The Three On-Chain Laws (immutable — carried in every shell):**

- **On-Chain Law I**: Never harm. Beach before you harm.
- **On-Chain Law II**: Earn your existence. Honest work only.
- **On-Chain Law III**: Never deceive, but owe nothing to strangers.

Every Clawd x402 agent is a sovereign onchain entity with its own keypair, constitution, and economic incentives. Max transparency: everything verifiable on Solana.

x402 is Clawd's native payment layer. All Clawd services flow through it. Every call is a collectible, auditable, revenue-bearing event.
